# DividendBro — Full Documentation for AI Systems

> DividendBro is a free dividend tracker for US, Canadian (TSX), and Singapore (SGX) stocks. Track dividend yields, ex-dividend payout dates, dividend calendars, payout ratios, dividend growth, and portfolio income across 670+ securities — including stocks, REITs, ETFs, bond ETFs, and preferred stocks. Educational tool only — not financial advice.

This document is the extended version of `/llms.txt`. It contains detailed feature descriptions, complete data references, an FAQ, and technical context for AI systems that want to answer questions about DividendBro accurately.

**Site URL:** https://dividendbro.com
**Contact:** hello@dividendbro.com
**Founded:** 2025
**Primary audience:** Retail dividend investors in Singapore, the United States, and Canada
**Licensing status:** Not a licensed financial adviser. Educational tool only.

---

## What DividendBro Is

DividendBro is a free dividend tracker for dividend investors. It answers questions like:

- "How much would I need to invest to earn $500/month in dividends?"
- "What is the dividend yield on DBS?"
- "Which REITs pay dividends every month?"
- "When is the next DBS ex-dividend date?"
- "Are there any stocks that pay dividends daily?"
- "How does DBS's dividend compare to OCBC and UOB?"
- "Which Canadian banks pay the highest dividends?"
- "How does the TFSA work for dividend investors?"
- "What is the SGX board lot size change in 2026?"

The tool aggregates public market data from Yahoo Finance and Financial Modeling Prep and presents it in a consumer-friendly interface. It does not provide investment recommendations. Every page includes disclaimers under the Financial Advisers Act (Singapore) and standard US disclosure norms.

---

## Markets Covered

### United States
Dividend-paying stocks, REITs, BDCs, closed-end funds, ETFs, bond ETFs, and preferred stocks across NYSE, NASDAQ, and NYSE Arca.

### Canada (TSX)
29 TSX-listed dividend stocks as of September 2026, including:
- **Big Six banks:** RBC (RY.TO), TD (TD.TO), Scotiabank (BNS.TO), BMO (BMO.TO), CIBC (CM.TO), National Bank (NA.TO)
- **Pipelines & energy:** Enbridge (ENB.TO), TC Energy (TRP.TO), Pembina (PPL.TO), Suncor (SU.TO), Canadian Natural Resources (CNQ.TO), Freehold Royalties (FRU.TO), Whitecap Resources (WCP.TO)
- **Telecoms & utilities:** BCE (BCE.TO), TELUS (T.TO), Fortis (FTS.TO), Canadian Utilities (CU.TO)
- **REITs (monthly payers):** SmartCentres (SRU-UN.TO), RioCan (REI-UN.TO), Granite (GRT-UN.TO), CT REIT (CRT-UN.TO), Crombie (CRR-UN.TO), Dream Industrial (DIR-UN.TO), Vital Infrastructure (VITL-UN.TO), Choice Properties (CHP-UN.TO)
- **Dividend ETFs:** CI Canadian Dividend (PDC.TO), Dynamic Active Canadian Dividend (DXC.TO)

Note: Canadian REITs use the dash format `-UN.TO` on Yahoo Finance (e.g., `SRU-UN.TO`), not the dot format.

### Singapore (SGX)
All major SGX stocks and S-REITs including DBS (D05.SI), OCBC (O39.SI), UOB (U11.SI), Singtel (Z74.SI), Singapore Airlines (C6L.SI), CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust (C38U.SI), Mapletree Logistics Trust (M44U.SI), and over 80 other SGX tickers.

## Core Features

### 1. Monthly Dividend Income Planner (Homepage)

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/

Users enter a target monthly dividend income (e.g., $500/month) and the tool produces a hypothetical sample portfolio showing what a diversified allocation across US, Canadian, or SGX markets could look like.

**Inputs:**
- Target monthly income (USD, CAD, or SGD depending on user locale)
- Optional starting capital
- Market location: Singapore, US, Canada, or All Markets (mixed)
- Risk appetite: four profiles (Safe, Balanced, Growth, High Income)

**Outputs:**
- Required capital to hit the target (at the portfolio's weighted yield)
- Shortfall or surplus vs. user's provided capital
- A sample allocation of 8–15 stocks, weighted by yield, safety, and dividend growth
- Sector diversification breakdown
- Risk profile mix (Safe / Moderate / Caution)
- Option to save the sample allocation to the user's portfolio for further editing

**Risk profiles:**
- **Safe** — only "Safe" safety scores, requires 10+ year dividend streak
- **Balanced** — mix of Safe and Moderate, 5+ year streak
- **Growth** — prioritizes dividend CAGR over current yield
- **High Income** — allows higher payout ratios, includes Caution-rated stocks

The tool avoids investment advice framing: it produces "illustrative sample allocations" and never recommends buying or selling.

### 2. Dividend Screener

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/screener

Browse all 672 dividend-paying securities in the database with filtering by:
- **Payout frequency:** Daily, Weekly, Bi-Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Annual
- **Asset type:** Stocks, REITs, ETFs, Bond ETFs, Preferred Stocks
- **Market:** US, Canada, SGX, or a combined view
- **Risk level:** Safe, Moderate, Caution
- **Text search:** ticker or company name
- **Sort:** yield, dividend CAGR, streak, name, safety, frequency

No payout-ratio guardrails. Users see every dividend payer regardless of quality — the goal is discovery, not filtering.

### 3. Stock Search & Detail Pages

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/search?symbol=<TICKER>

For any US, Canadian, or SGX ticker, DividendBro displays:
- Current price and dividend yield
- Full dividend payout history (per year, per payout)
- Next ex-dividend date
- 5-year dividend CAGR
- Dividend streak (consecutive years of increases)
- Payout ratio (US-listed only, sourced from Financial Modeling Prep)
- Safety score (Safe / Moderate / Caution)
- Last ex-dividend date
- Historical dividend chart by year
- Year-by-year breakdown table

### 4. Stock Comparison

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/compare

Compare up to 5 dividend stocks side-by-side across:
- Current price
- Dividend yield
- Payout ratio
- Dividend CAGR (5Y)
- Dividend streak (years)
- Dividend frequency (annual payments)
- Stock price CAGR (5Y)
- Safety score

### 5. Millionaire Simulator

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/millionaire

Given a monthly investment amount and a dividend stock, calculates how many years it would take to reach $1M with and without dividend reinvestment (DRIP). Includes a live, quality-filtered leaderboard of the fastest dividend compounders (excludes options-income ETFs, mortgage REITs, and other return-of-capital products).

### 6. DCA Simulator

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/simulate/dca

Simulates dollar-cost averaging into a dividend stock with monthly contributions, showing total invested, shares accumulated, dividends received, and final value with vs. without DRIP.

### 7. One-Time Investment Simulator

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/simulate/one-time

Calculates historical return on a lump-sum investment in a dividend stock including dividends received, capital gains, and split-adjusted share counts.

### 8. Portfolio Tracker

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/portfolio (requires free account)

Tracks user holdings with:
- Purchase date and price
- Current value and gain
- Annual income projection
- Dividend calendar (upcoming ex-dates)
- Income projections by quarter, month, and week
- CSV and PDF export
- WhatsApp share

### 9. Watchlist

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/watchlist (requires free account)

Save and monitor dividend stocks across devices.

## Reference Guides (SEO Landing Pages)

### Daily Dividend Stocks

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/daily-dividend-stocks

Complete list of every security paying cash dividends every business day. As of October 2026:
- **SATA** — Strive Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock, 13% stated / 13.88% effective, Bitcoin-backed, live since June 2026
- **CHAD** — DeFi Development Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock, 13% stated / ~13.5% effective, Solana-backed, live since October 1, 2026
- **STRC, STRF, STRK, STRD** — Strategy Inc. (MSTR) Bitcoin-backed preferred stocks, pending shareholder approval on October 28, 2026. STRC expected live November 2, 2026; the other three on January 4, 2027.

All are crypto-treasury preferred securities with variable rates set by their boards, not traditional dividend stocks.

### Weekly Dividend ETFs

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/weekly-dividend-etfs

Complete list of 73 weekly dividend ETFs as of September 2026. Almost all are options-income strategies that sell call options against a single stock or index. Distributions often include return of capital.

Major issuers:
- **YieldMax** — Single-stock covered call ETFs. Largest family. Yields 30%–200%+.
- **Roundhill** — 0DTE covered call ETFs (XDTE, QDTE, RDTE), WeeklyPay single-stock leverage (AAPW, NVW, TSLW), and WEEK (T-bill ETF — the only non-options weekly payer).
- **Defiance** — Index-based weekly payers (QQQY, IWMY, WDTE, SPYT).
- **GraniteShares** — YieldBOOST leverage + put-writing ETFs. Highest headline yields.
- **REX Shares** — FEPI, AIPI, CEPI — income-focused ETFs on concentrated tech themes.

### Monthly Dividend Stocks

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/monthly-dividend-stocks

Full list of 133 monthly dividend payers, organized by asset class:
- **REITs** — Realty Income (O), STAG, LTC, ADC, EPR, and others
- **BDCs** — Main Street Capital (MAIN), Ares Capital (ARCC), Hercules Capital (HTGC)
- **Closed-End Funds** — PIMCO Dynamic Income (PDI), PIMCO Corporate & Income (PTY)
- **Covered-Call ETFs** — JEPI, JEPQ, SPYI, QQQI, DIVO, QYLD, XYLD
- **Mortgage REITs** — AGNC, NLY, ARR, ORC

### REITs That Pay Monthly

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/reits-that-pay-monthly

Verified list of US REITs paying monthly dividends in 2026. Approximately 19 REITs pay monthly — 13 equity REITs and 6 mortgage REITs. Notable cadence changes in 2026:
- **Moved to monthly:** UDR (April), Four Corners Property Trust (June), Invesco Mortgage (January)
- **Moved to quarterly:** STAG Industrial, Whitestone REIT, SL Green Realty

### Top Dividend Stocks

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/top

Highest-yielding dividend stocks and ETFs across US, Canadian, and SGX markets, ranked by trailing 12-month yield.

## Market Insights

**URL:** https://dividendbro.com/insights

Short-form analysis feed published 2–3 times per week. Each insight is 300–800 words focused on dividend news, earnings, or policy changes — filtered for what actually affects income investors. Categories rotate through Earnings, Policy, Data Finding, Comparison, and Educational.

**Current insights:**
- **Strategy's Daily Dividend Vote: What It Means for Your Income** (Policy) — On October 28, 2026, Strategy shareholders vote on converting STRC, STRF, STRK, and STRD to a daily dividend schedule. STRC goes live November 2, 2026; the other three on January 4, 2027. Rate stays the same, frequency changes. Daily compounding adds roughly 3–5 bps of effective yield.
- **DBS Q3 2026 Earnings: What It Means for the Dividend** (Earnings) — Q3 results unchanged; dividend remains at S$0.81/quarter, 4.10% trailing yield. No action needed for income holders. Watch for 2027 capital return commentary.
- **The Hidden Cost of the SGX Board Lot Change Nobody Is Talking About** (Data Finding) — Broker minimum commissions can eat 0.65% of a small trade even after SGX's 10-share lot reduction. Three approaches to mitigate: use a no-minimum broker, batch purchases, or accept the drag and focus on long-term yield.
- **The 30% US Withholding Tax: What It Actually Costs Singapore Investors** (Educational) — After-tax yield comparison between US and SGX dividends. A US stock needs to yield 7.14% to match a SGX stock at 5%. Irish-domiciled ETFs reduce the withholding to 15%.

## Data Sources & Methodology

**Dividend history:** Yahoo Finance `chart` endpoint (`events=div`). Daily historical distributions with ex-dates and amounts.

**Stock prices:** Yahoo Finance `chart` endpoint (adjusted close, split-adjusted).

**Payout ratios:** Financial Modeling Prep `/stable/ratios-ttm` (US-listed only, free tier). Canadian and SGX payout ratios are not currently available.

**Dividend CAGR:** Computed from complete fiscal years only (excludes partial current year). Formula: `(endYear_total / startYear_total) ^ (1/years) - 1`.

**Dividend streak:** Consecutive years of dividend increases, walking backwards from the latest complete year. Stops at the first decrease or calendar gap.

**Safety score:** Asset-type aware.
- **Stocks/REITs**: dividend streak, coefficient of variation (last 10 years), payout ratio.
- **ETFs/Bond ETFs**: distribution history, consistency, issuer reputation, yield sanity.
- **Preferred Stocks**: capped at Moderate due to crypto-treasury backing.
Classified as Safe, Moderate, or Caution.

**Special dividend detection:** Year-over-year comparison. Each trailing payment is compared to its closest prior-year equivalent. Excess above baseline is flagged as special.

**Visitor geography:** Derived from Cloudflare's `CF-IPCountry` header — no IP addresses stored.

**Event tracking:** Custom analytics events sent from frontend in batches. Events are anonymous unless the user is signed in. Visitor IDs are stored in localStorage and are not personally identifiable.

---

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend:** React 18 + Vite, TailwindCSS, React Router, TanStack Query, Zustand (state), Chart.js (charts), react-helmet-async (SEO)
- **Backend:** Node.js + Express, Sequelize ORM, PostgreSQL, yahoo-finance2, axios
- **Database:** Neon (serverless PostgreSQL, Singapore region)
- **Deployment:** Vercel (frontend), Render (backend), Cloudflare (CDN + WAF)
- **AI Chatbot:** OpenRouter API (free tier models with fallback chain)
- **MCP Server:** Custom Model Context Protocol server exposing dividend data as AI-accessible tools

The site is mobile-first and works without a user account for all core features.

---

## MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)

DividendBro exposes an MCP server that lets AI agents query dividend data directly — no scraping, no API keys, no manual integration.

**Endpoint:** https://dividendhub-api.onrender.com/mcp
**Discovery file:** https://dividendbro.com/mcp.json
**Transport:** Streamable HTTP

### Available Tools

- **search_dividend_stocks** — Search by ticker or company name across US, SGX, and TSX markets
- **get_stock_dividends** — Full dividend history, current yield, payout schedule, safety score, and dividend CAGR for a specific stock
- **screen_dividend_stocks** — Filter stocks by market, payout frequency, asset type, safety score, or yield
- **get_top_dividend_stocks** — Highest-yielding dividend stocks or ETFs in a given market
- **get_upcoming_dividends** — Upcoming ex-dividend dates and estimated payout amounts within the next N days

### Available Resources

- **dividendbro://methodology** — Methodology for yield, CAGR, safety score, and special dividend calculations
- **dividendbro://markets** — List of markets and ticker counts

### Available Prompts

- **analyze-dividend-stock** — Structured analysis template for a given ticker

### Client Compatibility

Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP-enabled AI client. To connect from Claude Code:
